accessory_sets.name: Traditional
accessory_sets.description: The choice with a clean, timeless, and traditional finish. It delivers all the essential tools for everyday sauna use.
accessory_sets.inclusions: Wooden Pail Basic 4L, Wooden Ladle Standard (36cm), Wooden Thermometer Cut Corner Square, Wooden Sandtimer Basic 45x300mm, Sauna Signage, and Sauna Guidelines

accessory_sets.name: Essential
accessory_sets.description: The Essential set takes comfort and style to the next level, offering a wider collection of sauna items to enjoy.
accessory_sets.inclusions: Wooden Pail 4L, Wooden Ladle (36cm), Wooden Thermohygrometer, Wooden Sandtimer, Aroma Cup, Aroma Oil Eucalyptus Scent (250ml), Sauna Signage, and Sauna Guidelines

accessory_sets.name: Signature
accessory_sets.description: The distinguished Signature set is for those seeking an elegant and sophisticated sauna experience.
accessory_sets.inclusions: Wooden Pail Kanto 4L, Wooden Ladle Puro (51cm), Thermo-Hygrometer Square, Wooden Sandtimer, Wooden Pillow Wave, Aroma Cup, Aroma Oil Eucalyptus Scent (250ml), Sauna Signage, and Sauna Guidelines Hemlock

accessory_sets.name: Dragon
accessory_sets.description: With unparalleled style and innovation, the Dragon set offers a unique, bold look with added flair. This set is part of the Dragonfire Series, designed by renowned Finnish designer Stefan Lindfors.
accessory_sets.inclusions: Dragon Pail 4L, Wooden Ladle Dragon, Thermo-Hygrometer Square, Wooden Sandtimer, Wooden Pillow Wave, Aroma Cup, Aroma Oil Eucalyptus Scent (250ml), Sauna Signage, and Sauna Guidelines Cedar
